title: Kibble--Zurek Scaling in the Dicke Model at Mesoscopic Scales
summary: The Dicke model is a paradigmatic setting for collective light-matter physics and the superradiant phase transition. Yet extracting the critical exponents is challenging at experimentally accessible mesoscopic sizes, due to the slow divergence of the correlation time under all-to-all coupling and a photon-loss-driven crossover to a distinct dissipative universality class. Here, we perform a large-$N$ analysis that identifies distinct coherent and dissipative fixed points for the closed and open Dicke models.
